sites.name: aShemaleTube
sites.testResult: Downloaded the full video through the plugin (118 MB): H.264 852x480 with AAC audio, 18:58, title "Skinny ts takes bbc". Every frame decoded cleanly. A second video (900378) also resolved to its 480p stream; six repeated page loads all passed Cloudflare on the first try.
sites.notes: yt-dlp has no extractor for this site. The page is behind a Cloudflare challenge: plain requests, including Siphon's recipe fetches, get HTTP 403 whatever their headers, and so does yt-dlp unless it impersonates a browser's TLS fingerprint. Desktop Chrome fingerprints pass; Safari's never do, and a bare "chrome" target fails about half the time, so the plugin requests chrome-131:macos-14 and retries other desktop Chrome versions on a 403. The video is in the player config as sources.hlsAuto, an HLS master playlist (480p and 240p) on cdn.ashemaletube.com that needs no referer or cookies. The generic extractor can't read it because it's a JavaScript object, not markup. A recipe can't fix this until recipes can fetch through Cloudflare.
